map.艾灸壮数(皮肤反应)个体化推荐器 使用指南: Moxibustion cone count (skin reaction) individualized recommender guide
map.艾灸壮数推荐器，根据皮肤反应与证候虚实个体化推荐艾灸壮数并设安全上限，防范烫伤，: The moxa cone recommender individualizes the number of cones from skin reaction and deficiency/excess patterns, with a safety ceiling to prevent burns and standardize moxibustion stimulus.
map.虚寒胃痛，灸中脘、足三里，壮数适中。: For deficiency-cold stomach pain, moxa Zhongwan and Zusanli with a moderate cone count.
map.阳虚怕冷，灸命门、关元，壮数可增。: For yang deficiency with cold intolerance, moxa Mingmen and Guanyuan with the cone count increased.
map.阴虚火旺、皮肤红烫，立即减壮停灸。: For yin deficiency with heat and hot red skin, reduce cones or stop at once.
map.：成人虚寒腹泻，灸神阙（隔姜灸）每穴 3–5 壮、每日 1 次；若灸处皮肤明显红: : for an adult with deficiency-cold diarrhea, moxa Shenque (with ginger separation) 3-5 cones per point, once daily; if the site turns clearly red, hot and burning, cut to 1-2 cones or stop to prevent burns; halve the count for children and those with impaired sensation, with a caregiver present.

map.穴位配伍（开四关）组合推荐: Acupoint combination (Open the Four Gates) recommendation
map.传统以一艾炷（如麦粒大）燃尽为一壮；现代多用艾条悬灸计时（每穴 10–15 分钟: Traditionally one cone is one moxa cone (about the size of a grain of wheat) burnt out; modern practice mostly uses a moxa stick held above the skin and timed (10-15 min per point); the two can be converted, with warm comfort as the guide.
map.立即停灸冷却、勿挑破水疱，重者就医；本工具设安全上限仅供参考。: Stop moxibustion at once and cool the area, do not break the blisters, and seek care if severe; the safety ceiling set by this tool is reference only.
